say:3:1013612002:1.text: One day, that big brute stormed into our camp, throwing punches everywhere.
say:3:1013612002:1.source_cn: 嚯，那个大老粗……有一天突然就挥着拳头闯进营地里。把我...

say:4:1013612003:1.text: The Syndicate folks saw him and insisted he become the leader! We wanted nothing to do with him, but none of us could defeat him so...
say:4:1013612003:1.source_cn: 正好被黑金的人看见了，非要让他当老大！要不是打不过，我...

choice_prompt:5:1013612003.text: The Syndicate folks saw him and insisted he become the leader! We wanted nothing to do with him, but none of us could defeat him so...
choice_prompt:5:1013612003.source_cn: 正好被黑金的人看见了，非要让他当老大！要不是打不过，我们真、真不想理他……

say:6:1013612004:1.text: Yeah, I mean the training was so hard! He made us run between two camps ten times a day! Who can handle that?
say:6:1013612004:1.source_cn: 训练太累了！他让我们每天从两个营地之间来回跑十次！这谁...

say:7:1013612005:1.text: I hate him! Some people tried to sneak away, but once they got caught, the training became even more horrifying!
say:7:1013612005:1.source_cn: 真是恨死他了！有些人偷偷跑了，但被抓回来之后就是更可怕...

say:9:1013612006:1.text: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...
say:9:1013612006:1.source_cn: 还不是因为他能打呗！但要我说，他脑子有点不好使……
say:9:1013612006:1.male: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...
say:9:1013612006:1.female: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...

say:10:1013612007:1.text: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
say:10:1013612007:1.source_cn: 下面有人欺上瞒下，他也一直没发现……
say:10:1013612007:1.male: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
say:10:1013612007:1.female: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...

say:12:1013612008:1.text: Oh no! I didn't say anything, stop asking! Anyway, it has nothing to do with the big brute or the Syndicate!
say:12:1013612008:1.source_cn: 糟糕！我什么都没说，你别问了！反正与大老粗和黑金都没有关系！
